snippet.title: Stack the States
snippet.description: Stack the States for the iPhone and iPad makes learning about the 50 states fun!  Watch the states actually come to life in this colorful and dynamic game! As you learn state capitals, shapes, geographic locations and more, you can actually touch, move and drop the animated states anywhere on the screen. Carefully build a stack of states that reaches the checkered line to win each level.  You earn a random state for every successfully completed level.  All of your states appear on your own personalized map of the United States.
